cannotTest: Whether the other listed libraries (responsive-layout, tabs, responsive-table, sidekick-menu, overflow-menu, jattac-web-poller) are used in preference to hand-built equivalents (custom tab bars, dropdown menus, setInterval polling, side navigation, layout grids, or a hand-written table) cannot be decided by a pattern, so a reviewer must judge it. Native <table> was deliberately not forbidden because this repository is itself the responsive-table library. Existing uses of native elements in this library's own source, if any, will be flagged by the checks and need review.
